body:
Founder real-time: 'continue PARENA build it with BAZEL' -> 'build system' -> 'ensure bazel is in the ci github workflows.' Installed bazelisk (go install, no sudo). New: MODULE.bazel (bzlmod, rules_cc dep), .bazelversion (pins 9.2.0), .bazelrc (global -std=c99 -Wall -Wextra -pedantic + a real --config=asan replacing the old raw gcc ASan invocation), src/BUILD.bazel + tests/BUILD.bazel. Verified locally: bazel build //..., bazel test //tests:..., bazel test --config=asan //tests:..., bazel run //src:parena -- parse examples/test.prn -- all clean, same 32/32 test result the Makefile build already had. CI migrated to run entirely through Bazel (bazel-contrib/setup-bazel), confirmed green on GitHub. Makefile kept for fast local iteration, not removed. Separately: 'and pandas build pandas into the standard library' -> designed dataframe (Column tagged union: NumericCol wraps array's NDArray, StringCol wraps Vec String; DataFrame + read-csv/column/select/filter/group-by; merge/join/pivot/time-series explicitly deferred). 'add any more stdlib you can think of that would be needed to port gpt2alpinec' -> read the real gpt2-alpine-c source, grounded three new packages in its actual function calls: nn (layernorm/gelu/softmax, deliberately not a fused attention call), tokenizer (load/encode/decode, a real region-owned value replacing the source's hidden global singleton), sort (generic top-k/sort-by, grounded in archetype.c's real qsort usage) + io/read-floats (grounded in gpt2.c's own fread_or_fail raw weight loading). Commits ed8b011, 4d6ac03, 59f08b5.

⚓ ☃
title: Bazel build system + pandas/gpt2-alpine-c-grounded stdlib extensions
